title: Swapping two slugs fails because Yoast immediately redirects the freed slug
symptoms: The slug you freed redirects to the old page
Reclaiming a URL lands on a 301
cause: Yoast Premium creates a 301 the moment a slug changes, so freeing a slug books a redirect that then hijacks the URL you want to reuse.
fix: Rename the current owner, delete the auto-created redirect on the freed slug, rename the real page onto it, then confirm Yoast created the redirect from the real page's old URL.
